map.重复性标准偏差 = 平均极差 / d₂。: Repeatability standard deviation = average range / d2.
map.极差法快速估算。: The range method gives a quick estimate.
map.d₂ 随测量次数变化。: d2 varies with the number of measurements.
map.算同一人重复测量变异: Compute the variation of repeated measurements by one operator
map.重复性 EV = Rbar * K1（极差法）。例：Rbar=0.003、K1=: Repeatability EV = Rbar * K1 (range method). Example: Rbar=0.003, K1=0.5908 (2 trials) gives EV=0.0018.
map.查 d₂=2.059，σ_r=0.07/2.059=0.0340；99% 过程带: Looking up d2 = 2.059 gives σ_r = 0.07/2.059 = 0.0340; the 99% process spread is 5.15σ_r = 0.1751. Since d2 changes with the number of trials, choosing the wrong one visibly skews the result.
map.重复性同人同具，再现性跨人/设备。: Repeatability is the same operator with the same gage; reproducibility spans operators and equipment.
map.EV% 应远小于公差或过程变异。: EV% should be far smaller than the tolerance or process variation.
